payload.reason: The evidence indicates that fine-tuning BERT on natural language inference datasets, specifically SNLI, improves the quality of embeddings, particularly for semantic similarity tasks.

claims.text: Fine-tuning BERT on natural language inference datasets improves the quality of sentence embeddings, especially on semantic similarity tasks.
Fine-tuning BERT on SNLI does not lead to significant improvement for QA datasets, indicating a domain mismatch.
